name: Shingyouji Souichi
source:
The head of the Shingyouji Group, one of Japan's leading companies. He's in his 40's, but he looks young.
An old friend of the protagonist's father.
He's interested in the protagonist's looks and wants her to marry into his family.
He's been divorced twice and is currently single.
